3546137942.title: HELLOLEIBOO | Portable Travel Pet Carrier for Cats and Small Dogs
3546137942.detail_text: Versatile Use Whether you're traveling by air or car, this versatile carrier is the ideal solution for transporting your pet safely and securely. Lightweight Design The cat carrier is designed for easy portability, making it perfect for travel. Its lightweight construction ensures comfort for both you and your pet. Large Capacity With its spacious design, this carrier can accommodate small dogs and large cats, providing ample room for your pet to move around comfortably. Car-specific Design This carrier is specifically designed for car travel, featuring secure straps that keep your pet in place during the journey. Aerospace-grade Material Crafted from high-quality aerospace-grade materials, this carrier is durable and reliable, ensuring your pet's safety during travel.

Versatile Use



Whether you're traveling by air or car, this versatile carrier is the ideal solution for transporting your pet safely and securely.






Lightweight Design

Large Capacity



With its spacious design, this carrier can accommodate small dogs and large cats, providing ample room for your pet to move around comfortably.






Car-specific Design

Aerospace-grade Material

3545732605.detail_text: Safety Features Equipped with secure fastenings, this pet cage provides safety and reassurance during transportation. Portable Design The compact and lightweight design of this pet crate makes it easy to carry, perfect for traveling with your furry friend. Easy Cleaning The crate's durable material is easy to clean, maintaining hygiene for your pet during long journeys. Comfortable Space The spacious interior of the crate ensures your pet has ample room to move around, reducing stress during travel. Size Compatibility Designed to accommodate both small and large dogs, ensuring a comfortable journey for pets of all sizes.

Safety Features



Equipped with secure fastenings, this pet cage provides safety and reassurance during transportation.






Portable Design



The compact and lightweight design of this pet crate makes it easy to carry, perfect for traveling with your furry friend.






Easy Cleaning



The crate's durable material is easy to clean, maintaining hygiene for your pet during long journeys.






Comfortable Space



The spacious interior of the crate ensures your pet has ample room to move around, reducing stress during travel.






Size Compatibility



Designed to accommodate both small and large dogs, ensuring a comfortable journey for pets of all sizes.

2970983686.title: Benepaw Dog Carrier Backpack Adjustable Pet Carriers Front Facing Hands-Free Safety Puppy Travel Bag For Small Medium Dog
2970983686.detail_text: Size: S Pet Back Length: 26cm; Pet Chest Length: 38-47cm; Pet Inside Leg Distance: 12-14cm M Pet Back Length: 31cm; Pet Chest Length:52-70cm; Pet Inside Leg Distance: 15-18cm L Pet Back Length:41cm ; Pet Chest Length: 60-78cm; Pet Inside Leg Distance: 19-22cm XL Pet Back Length: 54cm; Pet Chest Length:66-86cm; Pet Inside Leg Distance: 25-29cm Material: Nylon, mesh Features: Recommended to Small dogs and Cats Under 13.5kg/30 lbs: This front pet dog backpack carrier is designed for puppyies and cats. Body weight is for reference only. While picking the pet carrier backpack, please measure your pet and choose the right size according to our size chart. Better Breathability: The more open area and all the air mesh padding on this dog carrier backpack ensures breathability, keeping you and your pet from being stuffy and allowing your pet to move more freely without being restrained. Easy to Wear and Use： This dog back carrier backpack features an adjustable full buckle. Prevents our pets from getting caught in an old-fashioned zip-up dog carrier front pack and doesn't slip off as easily as zippers. This design allows us to quickly put on the pack for pets and adjust to a more suitable size for pets to keep them safe and comfortable. Comfort and Safety： The chest carrier for dogs uses thickened pearl cotton pads and buttons to move the point of force down from the pet's throat to the chest and abdomen, improving the pet's comfort and safety. And we widened the shoulder straps and added adjustable safety buckles on the back and waist to balance the weight and reduce the burden on the owner. Lightweight and portable： Benepaw adjustable and breathable hands-free pet carrier backpack can be worn on your front side or back side. Provides you and your furry friend with better ways to travel including hiking, traveling, walking, shopping, biking, camping or other more fun outdoor activities without hurting your pet's knees or waist.

Body weight is for reference only. While picking the pet carrier backpack, please measure your pet and choose the right size according to our size chart.  Better Breathability: The more open area and all the air mesh padding on this dog carrier backpack ensures breathability, keeping you and your pet from being stuffy and allowing your pet to move more freely without being restrained.  Easy to Wear and Use： This dog back carrier backpack features an adjustable full buckle. Prevents our pets from getting caught in an old-fashioned zip-up dog carrier front pack and doesn't slip off as easily as zippers. This design allows us to quickly put on the pack for pets and adjust to a more suitable size for pets to keep them safe and comfortable.  Comfort and Safety： The chest carrier for dogs uses thickened pearl cotton pads and buttons to move the point of force down from the pet's throat to the chest and abdomen, improving the pet's comfort and safety. And we widened the shoulder straps and added adjustable safety buckles on the back and waist to balance the weight and reduce the burden on the owner.  Lightweight and portable： Benepaw adjustable and breathable hands-free pet carrier backpack can be worn on your front side or back side. 1674951824.title: Ibiyaya Flying Pal Foldable Pet Travel Carrier Blue
1674951824.detail_text: Flying Pal is an airline-approved pet carrier for small dogs and cats that also functions as a car seat pet carrier by Ibiyaya. This foldable pet travel carrier is the perfect travel essential for your favorite travel fur buddy! Flying Pal is designed to make in-cabin pet travel easy and safe for pets, made with lead and phthalate-safe material. It has springy wire frame with soft-sided carrier material that flexes to fit under the cabin seats of major airline carriers. Flying Pal is also perfect when travelling by car with its safety belt buckles that allow it to be restrained with the vehicles seat belts. It also has large mesh panels that allow maximum viewing and ventilation for your pet; with both the side and front end open allowing easy access. The thick sturdy padding also makes sure your pet is at its most comfortable throughout your trip. There is also a comfy padded carry strap and a side pocket for convenient storage. Designed with also the pet moms and dads in mind, Flying Pal is ultra-lightweight, stylish, and durable making every travel with your pet easy and trouble-free.

product.desc:
Innovative Design



The creative gift box features an innovative design, perfect for pets on the go. It's a portable cat carrier that doubles as a dog cage, making it versatile for different needs.






Durable Material



Made from durable materials, this carrier is built to last. It can withstand the rigors of travel, ensuring your pet's safety and comfort during transportation.






Gift Box Included



The product comes in a creative gift box, making it an ideal present for pet lovers. It's a thoughtful gift that's sure to be appreciated by any pet owner.






Easy to Use



The carrier is easy to use, with simple assembly and disassembly. It's designed to be user-friendly, making it convenient for both you and your pet.






Compact Size



Its compact size makes it easy to carry around, ensuring your pet is comfortable during travel. It's ideal for small dogs and cats, providing ample space for them to move around.

2417870190.detail_text: [SG] ONECUTE Comfy Pet Shoulder Carrier Outdoor Travel Bag - Spacious Casual Everyday Bag for Dogs & Cats - Beige & Grey Looking for a cute and trendy everyday style pet carrier? Well here you have it! Each carrier is designed to be sturdy yet comfortable for your pets. The side window can be fully opened, opened halfway, or closed. Each carrier has pockets so that you can carry your day to day needs or just snacks for your pets! Product Dimension: Small: 34*15*25 cm (for pets below 3.5kg - small breeds & puppies) Medium: 41*19*31cm (for pets below 6kg - small to medium breeds)

3490965467.title: (FREE DELIVERY) Petmate Vari Kennel Ultra Traditional for Pets | Dog and Cat | Travel Pet Carrier | Pet Cage
3490965467.detail_text: The Petmate Ultra Vari Kennel provides your pet with a safe travel & training kennel. The durable plastic shell comes with heavy-duty, easy-to-assemble hardware. Each kennel features an easy-open squeeze latch, metal side events to promote healthy air flow & an interior floor moat to keep a pet dry. Convenient tie-down strap holes allow you to zip-tie the kennel together for added security during airline travel. For airline travel, the Ultra Vari Kennel meets most air travel requirements. For a smoother journey, pet parents should contact their specific airline beforehand for verification. PRODUCT NOTE: Only sizes 21" and 28" include a handle. All other sizes do not come with a handle. product.desc:
The Petmate Ultra Vari Kennel provides your pet with a safe travel & training kennel. The durable plastic shell comes with heavy-duty, easy-to-assemble hardware. Each kennel features an easy-open squeeze latch, metal side events to promote healthy air flow & an interior floor moat to keep a pet dry. Convenient tie-down strap holes allow you to zip-tie the kennel together for added security during airline travel. For airline travel, the Ultra Vari Kennel meets most air travel requirements. For a smoother journey, pet parents should contact their specific airline beforehand for verification.

PRODUCT NOTE: Only sizes 21" and 28" include a handle. All other sizes do not come with a handle.

INTERIOR DIMENSIONS:

21" Interior Dims: 18.75" L x 13.5" W x 14.5" H

28" Interior Dims: 24.25" L x 18.25" W x 19.5" H

32" Interior Dims: 29.5" L x 19.75" W x 23.5" H

36" Interior Dims: 32.5" L x 26" W x 26" H

40" Interior Dims: 36.25" L x 24.75" W x 28.8" H

48" Interior Dimensions: 44" L x 29" W x 32.5" H

SAFETY DESIGN: The high-quality self-locking zipper can only be opened from the outside, prevent any accidental openings from the inside. CONVENIENCE: This small dog carrier has side pocket for food, bowl, or training items, like toys. The bottom side of thecarrier design with four bottom protection, it can keep yourcarrier clean, and the top side of thecarrier is designed with an ID card pocket allows for placement of the pet's identification, such as ID tags, contact information, or ownership proof. product.desc:
Aerodynamic Standards



Designed to meet airline standards, this pet bag allows your furry friend to travel comfortably in the cabin.






Versatile Use



Whether it's for a dog or a cat, this versatile pet bag is the ideal companion for your pet's travel needs.






Expandable Capacity



The expandable capacity of this pet bag provides ample space for your pet to move around, ensuring their comfort during travel.






Portable and Lightweight



Lightweight and portable, this pet bag is easy to carry, ensuring your pet's travel is as stress-free as possible.






Foldable Design



The pet travel bag features a foldable design, making it easy to store and carry around. Perfect for quick trips or long journeys.
